_comment: FTUE script: the six-step first run of docs/05-UX_FLOW.md section 4, under 60 s, no store / ads / pass, one panel deep. Steps 1-5 are one scripted turn (level_001's first clear) on the 1-zone starter grill; step 6 is on Home. Run by tools/sim-core/src/tutorial.ts (TutorialDirector + TutorialTurn), tested in tools/studio/test/tutorial.test.ts, cross-checked by npm run validate (ids, l10n keys, analytics events, step-6 affordability).
_coach: flipPromptAtSideDoneness: the flip prompt waits for a browned face-down side (docs/20: 'espere dourar'). serveReadyMinDoneness: the serve prompt waits until a serve scores PERFEITO. holdBelowWindowHi: while the guided plate waits for its flip or serve, no side passes perfectWindow[1] minus this, so it can neither overcook nor burn (docs/19 section 6). idleHintSec: step 5 has no prompt; the hand returns after this much idle time.
_school: Escola da Brasa — the first-impression lesson deck. A lesson with a `step` also shows as a two-line card (`shortKey`) while that guided step is on screen; the full deck plays once right after the scripted turn and pays `rewardXp`, which is enough to reach level 2 on a fresh save (the second cut unlocks, so session 1 ends with something new to cook). Re-openable from Home, where it never pays again. Geometry/drawing: prototype/src/school-ui.ts.
